text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Iran wants to build an oil refinery in the northern Mozambican port city of Nacala and to produce butane gas at the country's existing refinery at Matola in the south. The Iranian ambassador in Maputo says his government made the proposal five months ago but the Mozambican authorities have not yet announced a decision.

- South Africa's Industrial Development Corporation has decided that an iron ore reduction plant will be built near Maputo and not in the Phalaborwa area of South Africa where the ore is situated, the IDC's Etienne Roux said in Johannesburg. The plant will use Mozambique's natural gas.
